items.heading: Strip Away the "Media Strip
items.text: Strip Away the "Media Strip Strip Away the "Media Strip away the "media and events" branding and the job is this: you manage what gets said about a person, brand, or organisation, through people who are not on your payroll, journalists, editors, influencers, and industry voices, instead of through ads the brand pays for directly. That means writing press releases and media pitches, building and maintaining a real network of media contacts, planning and executing campaigns tied to a launch or a moment, monitoring coverage and sentiment, and stepping in fast when something goes wrong.

items.heading: This Is the Single Biggest
items.text: This is the single biggest early decision in a PR career, and it is not about which one is "better" - it is about what you need at your current stage.
